name: CoCANoT-Pipelines
welcome_text:
Welcome to the CoCANoT installer.

This installer provides the unified CoCANoT de-identification and
validation application together with its private runtime dependencies.
readme_text:
CoCANoT includes:

- Unified React + PyWebView application
- Imaging de-identification workflow
- Electrophysiology de-identification workflow
- Clinical and surgical metadata management
- Python runtime and required Python packages
- dcm2niix
- FSL / FLIRT components required by PyDeface
- PyDeface

The installed runtime is private to the current macOS user and is stored
under that user's Library folder. It does not modify Homebrew, system
Python, Node, npm, Conda, or other users' accounts.

An "Uninstall CoCANoT" application is also installed for the current user.
It removes the
CoCANoT application, its private runtime, local CoCANoT application data,
caches, preferences, logs, and installer receipts. User-selected source,
derivatives, and BIDS output folders are not deleted.
conclusion_text:
CoCANoT was installed successfully.

Open "CoCANoT" from your user Applications folder.

"Uninstall CoCANoT" is also available in your user Applications folder.
